name: FW — Recurring Corporate Contract Types
results: Pest Control — The pest is never what Corporate originally described. — It's a former employee.
Delivery — The destination is always considerably more dangerous than stated. — The recipient doesn't know they ordered it.
Loss Prevention — Recover stolen goods without discussing why they were stolen. — The thief was the rightful owner.
Employee Wellness — Locate employees who disappeared after raising workplace concerns. — They're still working, somewhere.
Competitive Research — Corporate espionage. — The rival shares your client's parent company.
Brand Protection — Stop embarrassing information becoming public. — The information is a Receipt.
Procurement — Retrieve magical ingredients from somewhere extremely dangerous. — The ingredient is sentient and has opinions.
Customer Service — Deal with customers employees cannot legally kill. — The customer is right.
Franchise Expansion — Clear whatever occupies desirable commercial property. — The occupant has a lease older than the city.
Product Recall — Recover an item before customers discover what it does. — Someone already has, and they're organising.
Quality Assurance — Consume something nobody at Head Office was willing to test. — It tests you back.
Executive Protection — Protect somebody whose decisions caused the current problem. — The assassin is a Tally ally.
Hostile Acquisition — Acquire a rival company. 'Hostile' may be interpreted flexibly. — The rival would rather join the Last Independents.
